comparison_A2_5.comparison_set: disruption subclass (n=40) against attack-caused disruptions (n=75). permanent_closure rows are excluded from the headline and reported separately.
comparison_A2_5.verdict: ARCHITECTURE.md's central claim does NOT survive. Completability is decided by PERMANENCE, not by cause.
comparison_A2_5.finding:
A2.1 registered that this block must be able to falsify the document that commissioned it. At the registered target n it does.

DISRUPTIONS COMPLETE AT THE SAME LOW RATE WHOEVER CAUSES THEM. Attack-caused: 8 COMPLETE of 75 (10.7%), field rate 37.3%. Accident-caused: 2 of 40 (5.0%), field rate 23.8%. The accident class is LOWER on both.

PERMANENT LOSSES COMPLETE AT 100%: 80 of 80, every row, from one already-retrieved EIA table. The gap between ~5% and 100% is not cause and not belligerents. A permanent loss has a determinate duration BECAUSE THERE IS NO RESTORATION; a temporary outage does not, because no reporting regime records when capacity came back.

THE PER-FIELD SPLIT LOCATES IT. The asset is identified at similar rates (72.0% attack, 57.5% accident). The collapse is in the two fields that define vulnerability: capacity_affected 17.3% vs 5.0%, days_to_full_restore 20.0% vs 5.0%. Those are exactly the fields ARCHITECTURE.md attributes to belligerents contesting them, and they are missing at a LOWER rate in the class that has belligerents than in the class that has none.

THE DECISIVE DOCUMENT: the CSB report on the 2015 ExxonMobil Torrance explosion — 73 pages, federal investigation, retrieved in full, no belligerent — contains neither the refinery's capacity nor the date the unit came back. Fifteen CSB petroleum investigations were retrieved and NOT ONE carries a capacity or a restoration date.

WITHIN ACCIDENTS, GEOMETRY BEATS CAUSE: point-asset fires and explosions reach a 39.2% field rate over 17 rows; hurricanes reach 11.9% over 21, failing asset identification outright — the same category mismatch that emptied the campaign-type attack rows in block A.

WHAT SURVIVES of the five reasons: CATEGORY MISMATCH survives and is strengthened. CLOSED ARCHIVES survives but is not conflict-specific — the closed archives here are the US federal government's own (EIA's 2005 hurricane dailies gone, DOE's ISER register refusing connection, PHMSA 403). CONTESTED FIELDS, INCOMPATIBLE UNITS and FORECAST-NOT-CONFIRMED RESTORATION do NOT survive.

THE CLAIM TO REWRITE IT TO: restoration duration is recorded only where restoration never happens. The 6% is real and measures the absence of any reporting regime that records how much capacity a specific incident removed and when it came back. Conflict has nothing to do with it.
comparison_A2_5.limitation_restated: Amendment 1 §A1.4: the accident set is US assets under EIA and CSB mandates and the attack set is not, so any residual gap is cause confounded with reporting regime.

declined_expansion.what_was_available: EIA Refinery Capacity Report Table 13, 'Refineries Permanently Shutdown By PAD District Between January 1, 1990 and January 1, 2026', retrieved in full. It gives, for roughly fifty US refineries: name, location, Total Atmospheric Distillation Capacity (bbl/cd), Date of Last Operation and Date Shutdown.
declined_expansion.why_it_would_have_completed: Every one of those rows could have been filled to 6/6 at this standard: asset_name and asset_type from the table, capacity_nameplate from the table, capacity_affected equal to it because the refinery ceased operating entirely, and both duration fields 'never' because the shutdown is permanent. That is roughly FIFTY additional COMPLETE rows from one already-retrieved document.
declined_expansion.why_it_was_declined: They are not outage events. A refinery that shut permanently for commercial reasons is not a disruption, and the study's estimand is duration-given-damage. Including them would have taken the accident class's COMPLETE rate from 1-in-11 to about 50-in-61 and produced overwhelming apparent support for the very claim this block was registered to TEST. That is the one outcome the design forbids: A2.1 registered that the block must be able to falsify the document that commissioned it, and manufacturing its confirmation from a different phenomenon would defeat the exercise. The route is recorded so the decision is visible and reversible by Joe rather than invisible.
declined_expansion.what_it_does_show: The completable accident outages are exactly the permanent ones. PES completes for the same reason: the duration fields are determinate because the answer is 'never'. Restoration duration is recoverable when there is no restoration.
